note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: OpenAI gets U.S. regulatory approval for GPT-5.6 rollout: Axios report
items.blurb: Commerce Department cleared OpenAI to broadly release GPT-5.6 after security testing, ending a government-requested rollout limit.

items.title: Scoop: Trump administration lifts restrictions on OpenAI's GPT-5.6
items.blurb: Government lifts its hold on GPT-5.6's wide release after additional Commerce Department testing and company meetings.

items.title: OpenAI to publicly release GPT-5.6 AI models, ending government-requested limits
items.blurb: GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra and Luna go public Thursday, two weeks after a government-requested limit to trusted partners.

items.title: GPT-5.6 buzz builds: what to know about OpenAI's new Sol model
items.blurb: Ahead of Thursday's launch, OpenAI casts GPT-5.6 Sol as its strongest model against Anthropic's Fable 5 and Grok.

items.title: Chinese AI models are gaining ground with U.S. companies as OpenAI, Anthropic costs surge
items.blurb: Open-weight Chinese models near frontier benchmarks at a fraction of the cost, pulling cost-conscious U.S. firms from OpenAI and Anthropic.

items.title: The implications of Amazon's $25B bond sale, and Microsoft's evolving AI model strategy
items.blurb: Microsoft leans harder on its own MAI models in Office to cut OpenAI/Anthropic costs as hyperscalers raise debt for the buildout.

items.title: Anthropic says Claude has carved out its own space to ponder
items.blurb: Anthropic's introspection research probes whether Claude can report its own internal states, reviving debate over model self-awareness.

items.title: China's Alibaba bans Anthropic AI for employees after 'distillation attack' accusation
items.blurb: Alibaba will bar staff from using Anthropic's Claude from July 10, citing security risks, amid an escalating distillation-attack dispute.

items.title: Nvidia's next-gen AI rack system delayed to 2028 on manufacturing snags, SemiAnalysis says
items.blurb: The Kyber rack meant to house 2027 Rubin Ultra chips reportedly slips past a year; Nvidia says its roadmap is 'intact'.

items.title: Small language models power life-saving small AI
items.blurb: Pruned small models run offline on handheld pill scanners to detect counterfeit drugs where broadband and power are scarce.

items.title: Nasdaq jumps to start the week led by chip stocks, Dow briefly tops 53,000 for the first time
items.blurb: AI-chip demand keeps driving equities to records, underscoring how the compute buildout dominates market sentiment.

items.title: How the world's top AI models were revived
items.blurb: Behind-the-scenes account of the 20-day standoff that pulled Anthropic's Fable 5 and Mythos 5 offline before export controls were lifted.

items.title: The hunt for AI's next winners defined the stock market's holiday-shortened week
items.blurb: Money rotated toward AI security and infrastructure names; Palo Alto and CrowdStrike hit all-time highs.

items.title: Generalizable AI predicts immunotherapy outcomes across cancers and treatments
items.blurb: Harvard's COMPASS model, trained on 10,000+ tumors, predicts checkpoint-inhibitor response 8.5% more accurately than prior methods across cancers.

items.title: OpenAI proposes 5% stake to Trump administration to ease Washington pressure: Report
items.blurb: Altman floated giving Washington 5% of OpenAI via a public wealth fund, part of a mooted government stake in leading US labs.

items.title: OpenAI courts Trump administration as its latest investor
items.blurb: OpenAI's overture to seed a government-held fund echoes federal stakes already taken in Intel and IBM.

items.title: Teaching AI to run with the turbines
items.blurb: AI control systems are moving into power generation, where uptime and safety constraints reshape how models are deployed.

items.title: CNBC Daily Open: Chips are down, OpenAI woos the White House
items.blurb: Chip stocks sell off to start July as OpenAI reportedly floats a 5% U.S. government stake while courting the White House.

items.title: Microsoft commits $2.5 billion and 6,000 employees to new AI implementation unit
items.blurb: Microsoft dedicates $2.5B and 6,000 staff to deploying AI inside customer organizations, signaling a shift from models to implementation.

items.title: Karp unleashes on frontier AI labs
items.blurb: Palantir's Alex Karp publicly attacked leading AI labs, sharpening the industry's ideological rifts.

items.title: Nvidia offers start-up customers chance to swap compute power for revenue share
items.blurb: Nvidia will give fast-growing AI startups compute credits in exchange for a slice of future profits, deepening its ecosystem lock-in.

items.title: Trump puts allies on notice: AI power comes first
items.blurb: Washington treats frontier models and chips as instruments of influence, restricting allies' access to the most capable systems.

items.title: An AI system to help scientists write expert-level empirical software
items.blurb: LLM-plus-tree-search system generated 40 new single-cell analysis methods that beat top human-built tools on a public leaderboard.

items.title: Employers who laid off workers citing AI are starting to reverse course
items.blurb: Firms that cut staff expecting AI to fill the gap are rehiring; IBM plans to triple U.S. entry-level hiring in 2026.
